mapper.update: UPDATE `document_version` SET extracted_content_id = #{extractedContentId}, parse_status = #{parseStatus}, parser_version = #{parserVersion}, parsed_at = #{parsedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, version_number, content_id, content_hash, extracted_content_id, parse_status, parser_version, parsed_at, change_summary, created_by_user_id, created_at FROM `document_version` WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY version_number DESC
